name: Kurumi Sanae
source:
A third-year student at Shisui-kan Academy.
She serves as class president for Rei and the others’ class.

She has a quiet, reserved personality, is very considerate, and gives her all to everything she does.
Although she sometimes feels a little daunted by the responsibility of leading the class,
she keeps at it because she loves seeing everyone smile.

She’s skilled at all kinds of household chores, like cooking and cleaning.
She makes meals that keep well and can be eaten right after heating them up,
and when tidying up, she makes good use of dead space—so she’s more of a homebody than just “girly.”
Even at her age, she’s already the type of girl people say, “She’ll make a great mom.”

She has a clear complex about her lack of bust.
When she sees her well-endowed classmates, she looks on enviously, thinking, “(T-that’s so nice…)”

“...It’s a little depressing that you can tell whose laundry it is just by the bra size...”
